parameters.jsCode: const s=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); s.actions??={}; const op=String($json.operation||'get').toLowerCase(); const key=String($json.key||'').trim(); if(!key)throw new Error('ledger key required'); const now=new Date().toISOString(); const existing=s.actions[key]||null; if(op==='claim'){ if(existing)return[{json:{ok:true,claimed:false,key,record:existing}}]; const rec={status:'claimed',claimed_at:now,value:$json.value||{}}; s.actions[key]=rec; const keys=Object.keys(s.actions); if(keys.length>1000){for(const k of keys){if(k!==key&&s.actions[k]?.status==='completed'){delete s.actions[k];if(Object.keys(s.actions).length<=900)break;}}} return[{json:{ok:true,claimed:true,key,record:rec}}]; } if(op==='complete'){ if(!existing)throw new Error('cannot complete unclaimed action'); existing.status='completed'; existing.completed_at=now; existing.result=$json.value||{}; return[{json:{ok:true,key,record:existing}}]; } if(op==='fail'){ if(!existing)throw new Error('cannot fail unclaimed action'); existing.status='failed'; existing.failed_at=now; existing.error=$json.value||{}; return[{json:{ok:true,key,record:existing}}]; } if(op==='get')return[{json:{ok:true,key,record:existing}}]; if(op==='reset'){delete s.actions[key];return[{json:{ok:true,key,reset:true}}];} throw new Error(`Unsupported ledger operation: ${op}`);
